description: A Java Swing class defining a GUI form for application settings, including color pickers, checkboxes, buttons, and configuration options for a tuning/logging application.

classes.name: SettingsForm
classes.description: A JFrame subclass providing a GUI for configuring application settings, including color themes, table display options, clipboard formats, and file associations.

methods.name: initComponents
methods.description: Initializes all GUI components, layout, and event listeners for the settings form.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Loads current settings into GUI components for display and editing.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events on color labels and buttons, opening color choosers or applying/saving settings.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Reads GUI component values and updates the Settings object accordingly.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current Settings instance from SettingsManager.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Returns the current ECUEditor instance from ECUEditorManager.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves the current Settings object to persistent storage.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves a provided Settings object, updates UI, and refreshes visible tables.

methods.name: drawVisibleTables
methods.description: Redraws all visible tables in the editor after settings change.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse pressed events.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse released events.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse entered events.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse exited events.
